content.title: When does Euphoria season 3 come out?
content.text: Euphoria returns for its highly anticipated third season with Zendaya and the cast back for new episodesEuphoria Season 3 trailer releasedEuphoria fans won't have to wait much longer to catch new episodes - here's everything you need to know about when season three lands. HBO Max smash hit Euphoria makes its long-awaited return for its third season, four years on from its second run, with fans eagerly anticipating catching up with all of their beloved characters. The new series will mark a significant shift from previous seasons, as the formerly gritty teen drama leaves its high school backdrop behind in favour of the real world, reports the Mirror.What time is Euphoria coming out?Euphoria season three will premiere on HBO Max in the USA on Sunday, April 12 and will be airing on cable channel HBO at 9pm Eastern Daylight Time (EDT). Euphoria will be coming out on Sky Atlantic, NOW and HBO Max in the UK at 2am British Standard Time (BST) on Monday, April 13.You need to have either a Sky, NOW or HBO Max subscription to watch new episodes. Season three consists of eight episodes like the previous two outings and they will be airing weekly. The season three finale will be hitting screens on May 31 and it's unclear whether there will be further series after this.The main cast are returning including Zendaya as Ruby 'Rue' Bennett, Maude Apatow as Alexis 'Lexi' Howard, Alexa Demie as Madeleine 'Maddy' Perez, Jacob Elordi as Nathaniel 'Nate' Jacobs, Hunter Schafer as Jules Vaughn, and Sydney Sweeney as Cassandra 'Cassie' Howard. Tragically, star Angus Cloud died in the interim and won't feature in the new series, while season three marks the final performance for Grey's Anatomy star Eric Dane before his death earlier this year.Although it's not certain, lead star Zendaya appeared to confirm that season three would be the last for Euphoria. When asked on The Drew Barrymore Show recently, the Spider-Man star said: "I think so." She went on to tease that "closure is coming" and so perhaps the end is indeed approaching.We use your sign-up to provide content in ways you've consented to and improve our understanding of you. More infoEarly reviews for season three have been mixed and it will be down to fans to decide whether Euphoria still possesses the same spark it had when it first burst onto screens back in 2019. Season three has been a long time in the making and was delayed due to numerous reasons, including the Hollywood writers and actors strikes and scheduling conflicts.Furthermore, Euphoria creator Sam Levinson was occupied with his second HBO series The Idol with The Weeknd, which stalled progress on Euphoria.The Idol ultimately fell flat, with HBO cutting short the series featuring The Hills singer and Lily-Rose Depp.Season three of Euphoria features a five-year time-jump with the characters firmly out of high school and embarking on various paths in life, including Rue caught up in drug smuggling in Mexico and Nate and Cassie living the white picket dream much to her chagrin.Levinson previously teased: "I feel strongly this is our best season yet... I will say that Cassie and Nate do in fact get married."I'm confirming it. And I promise that it will be an unforgettable night."Euphoria season 3 will be premiering on Sky Atlantic, NOW and HBO Max on April 13
